statement: You are given a grid of 0s and 1s, where 1 is land and 0 is sea.
A move takes you from a land cell to a land cell directly above, below, left or right of it. Walking off the grid is possible only from a land cell on its outer edge.
Return the number of land cells from which no sequence of moves can lead off the grid.

examples.explanation: The land cell at (1, 0) sits on the edge, so it can walk off. The other three land cells form a group that touches no edge cell, so all three are trapped.
Both groups of land include a cell on the edge of the grid, so every land cell can walk off.
